examples.notes: Future occasion, so sense 2 — not the 'recently' sense

examples.english: It's been decided that I'm being transferred.

notes:
{今度|こんど} can mean 'this time,' 'next time,' or 'recently' depending on context.

Key patterns:
- {今度|こんど}⟦こそ→こそ：12731_koso⟧: this time for sure
- {今度|こんど}の〜: this coming ~ (e.g., {今度|こんど}の⟦{週末|しゅうまつ}→週末：03030_shuumatsu⟧)

Note: When declining an invitation, {今度|こんど}⟦また→また：00969_mata⟧ ('next time') can be a polite way to say 'not now' without committing to a specific future date.

Related:
- ⟦{次|つぎ}→次：00819_tsugi⟧: next (more specific)
- ⟦{今回|こんかい}→今回：01409_konkai⟧: this time (more formal)
